evidence.title: Anthropic appears to be A/B testing reduced effort levels in Claude Code

summary: Anthropic is experimenting with a new setting for its Claude Code AI that reduces the model’s computational effort, aiming to cut costs and speed up responses. The A/B test will compare user experience and output quality between the standard and reduced‑effort configurations.
title: Anthropic Begins A/B Testing Lower‑Effort Mode for Claude Code Assistant
